pack_layer_quantize: pack a model layer into a quantized QuantLinear module for mx/nvfp data types
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model in auto-round format with mx/nvfp data types to a directory
pack_layer_replace_linear: replace a standard nn.Linear layer with a packed QuantLinear layer in the model
save_quantized_with_tokenizer: save a quantized model along with its tokenizer and processor to an output directory
pack_layer_moe_amax: pack MOE model layers by computing input global scale from act_max values
